facts.note: Transcript states that at the temple's nine, Félix's watch showed twenty minutes to nine, and that his uncle made a scene about it in front of everyone.
Transcript states he went up to the library, stayed there alone, heard the temple strike ten, and did not look at his watch.

Transcript gives the thump in the atelier right above him at eighteen minutes past ten by his watch, followed by the repeater: ten slow deep notes counted, then doubled notes, then quick high ones not counted.

Transcript gives someone going quickly up past the library door at a quarter past ten by his watch, and someone coming quickly down at twenty-one minutes past ten by his watch; he did not see who, and the door was shut.
Transcript states his aunt's piano was playing downstairs when the thump came. The Chopin detail is music and is not on the sheet, so it is not added.
Transcript gives Girard entering the library at thirty-two minutes past ten by his watch, and the two sitting together until the temple struck eleven.
